'''Tainae''' is an [[Angan language]] of [[Gulf Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. Famba ({{coord|-7.506365|145.811363|type:city_region:PG|name=Famba}}, Paiguna, and Pio ({{coord|-7.504143|145.795808|type:city_region:PG|name=Pio}}) of [[Kotidanga Rural LLG]] are the main villages.<ref name=e25/><ref name="UN-PNG">{{cite web |url=https://data.humdata.org/dataset/village-coordinates-lookup |title=Papua New Guinea Village Coordinates Lookup |author=United Nations in Papua New Guinea |work=Humanitarian Data Exchange |version=1.31.9 |date=2018}}</ref>

A grammatical sketch of Tainae was written by Carlson (1991).<ref>Carlson, Terry. 1991. ''Tainae grammar essentials''. Manuscript. Ukarumpa: SIL-PNG.</ref>

* Unvoiced consonants are voiced intervocalically or when adjacent to a voiced consonant.
* /d/ is unvoiced {{IPAblink|t}} when following another consonant.
* /k/ is palatalized {{IPAblink|kʲ}} after /i/, and labialized {{IPAblink|kʷ}} adjacent to /u/.

Additionally, the following diphthongs can be found: /ai/, /ae/, /ao/, /au/, /oi/.

Stress is usually penultimate, unless that syllable contains /ɨ/, in which case stress moves leftwards to the first syllable that does not contain /ɨ/.<ref name=opd/>
